decisions.reason: The electronic music box fits the firm's push to blend tradition with technology, and with only one season of evidence its uncertain value justifies keeping this low-cost option open.
A wooden nativity stable is a perennial core Christmas item made in-house at little extra cost, so there is no evidence to justify abandoning it.
The modern incense smoker tests the contemporary-design direction cheaply within existing workshops, and after one season its prospects are still too uncertain to drop it.
